chunks: But when they roused Our anger We inflicted retributive punishment and drowned them all,

key_terms.آسَفُونَا: Roused Our anger / Caused Us grief
key_terms.انْتَقَمْنَا: We inflicted retribution / We took vengeance

ai.seo_question: What was the consequence for those who roused Allah's anger according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (40:25) is often linked to the Pharaoh's specific provocation of Prophet Musa, illustrating how persistent arrogance leads to inevitable divine retribution. The total drowning ('ajma'een') signifies the completeness of the punishment for those who fully entrenched themselves in disbelief, serving as a historical precedent for the ultimate fate of the oppressors.
